title: Verify the adopted-tooling fixes: `**` expansion, contract consistency, contract readability, vendor-refresh durability
executed_by: Lead (independent verification; no implementation was performed by this task)
verdict_reason: Two acceptance criteria of t4 fail on raw output this verifier produced, and the task-body outcome requirement for DEFECT 2 is only narrowed, not prevented: after the fix the generated repair contract no longer lists a path twice, but the REQUIRED edit it still demands (F3 / AGENTS.md, the real wave-1 t13 inputs) is still classified out_of_scope by the completion gate.
host_restart_required: Yes — no hot reload of plugin modules in this harness: the live session keeps running the PRE-FIX matcher until dsh restarts. Every module-level claim below is therefore proven by direct module import (pre-fix from git HEAD, post-fix from the working tree) and the mount proof, never by the live completion gate.
pre_fix_source: git show HEAD:packages/mpd-agent-teams-plugin/lib/** at 98680b1fb2bbf5c10c28cfbe44419e91595e1cb7, extracted into .mpd/t8-verify-work/prefix (workspace-local, gitignored)

checks.detail: PRE-FIX: pathMatchesScope('packages/foo/test/a.test.mjs','packages/foo/test/**')=false; classifyChangedPath=undeclared for the file and for a deeper file; evaluateQualityCompletion on a task declaring that glob with a changedPath under it: ok=false ('1 changed path(s) not covered by inScope'). checks.criterion: Contract contradiction reproduced against pre-fix generation, impossible after the fix — and the outcome named in the task body prevented
checks.detail: Pre-fix: replaying the REAL wave-1 inputs (archived team mpd-default-7332aba4, source t7 + review t10) through the pre-fix planQualityFollowUp reproduces the recorded repair task t13 BYTE-FOR-BYTE (inScope/outOfScope identical) with AGENTS.md in BOTH lists; validateCreateTask accepted the contradictory declaration (ok=true); the 60-combination property sweep produced 24 contradictory scopes. Post-fix: the same real inputs produce a contradiction-free scope (contradiction=undefined; sweep 0/60) and validateCreateTask refuses the pair while legitimate carve-outs stay legal. FAILED on the task-body requirement: under the post-fix scope the finding F3-agents-md-state-root-stale (file AGENTS.md, requiredFix carried by the generated acceptance) is STILL classified out_of_scope, exactly the wave-1 outcome ('rejected a REQUIRED edit and forced the member to declare it unmatched'). The code's own doc comment states the intended mechanism (the finding's file is 'carved OUT of the source contract's outOfScope'); the implementation keeps the prohibition and drops the file from inScope instead.

checks.criterion: A LIVE running task's contract is readable through the new surface and matches its declaration field-by-field
checks.detail: The REAL registered tool set was driven against a byte-identical copy of the live team record. 14/14 tools registered including agent_teams_task_contract. t4 (just completed), t6 (in_progress, another member's) and t8 (in_progress, mine) each report 13/13 compared fields identical to the durable record: task_id, subject, kind, status, assignee, attempt, attempt_id, dependencies, objective, in_scope, out_of_scope, acceptance, verify. t8's view also equals the assignment prompt verbatim (objective, 6 acceptance items, 4 verify commands). checks.criterion: Every change to adopted code is marked in-source as a LOCAL ADAPTATION at the point of change (t4 acceptance 4)
checks.detail: 7 registered regions (5 in quality-gates.js, 2 in tools.js) are correctly marked. But 17 added lines of adopted-code change in packages/mpd-agent-teams-plugin/lib/quality-gates.js lie OUTSIDE every region: the rewritten inScopeOverlap body (current lines 252-255), the new normalizeScopePattern helper (263-267) and the create-time contradiction gate inside validateCreateTask (405-412). They are unmarked and therefore unmanaged by the re-apply guard.

checks.criterion: A `vendor-agent-teams.mjs` run cannot silently drop the deltas (t4 acceptance 5, re-vendor case)
checks.detail: Simulated the hand re-materialize the guard exists for: quality-gates.js replaced by the last un-adapted revision (git HEAD), tools.js + mpd-deltas.js ours, then the guard's healing pass exactly as scripts/vendor-agent-teams.mjs runs it (line 122, applyAgentTeamsFixes({write:true})). Measured: --check refuses first (exit 1, good), then --write reports 'applied ... inserted: 5 regions' with exit 0 and the following --check exits 0 — while the healed file contains TWO `export function pathMatchesScope` declarations and the healed MODULE FAILS TO IMPORT (`Identifier 'pathMatchesScope' has already been declared`). The diff healed-vs-working tree shows what no guard pass restores: the upstream pathMatchesScope body keeps sitting above the inserted region and the three unmarked changes of C4b are silently absent.

checks.criterion: No agent-teams regression: plugin suite green and a MOUNTING boot applying the agent-teams row shows 0 apply-crash signatures (never --dump-config)
checks.detail: bun test packages/mpd-agent-teams-plugin: 83 pass / 0 fail / 312 expect() calls, exit 0. Mounted boot in an isolated DSH_HOME + HOME + WORKSPACE (dsh plugin add into a temp profile, then a boot carrying the full bundle plus a registration-instrumentation probe row): 0 apply-crash signatures (unsupported JSON schema | JsonSchemaError | plugin tree failed to load | failed to apply loader entry | without inject), probe reached DONE, AGENT_TEAMS_TOOLS_PRESENT=14/14 with agent_teams_task_contract=REGISTERED (proving the POST-FIX module was the one loaded), exit 124 = still serving at the 90s cap. Isolation: 0 new team records in the real workspace, 0 real-workspace session keys in the sandbox. No --dump-config result is cited as load evidence.

findings.problem: repairScopeFromFindings drops a finding's file from inScope when the source contract's outOfScope forbids it, but leaves the prohibition in outOfScope. Replaying the REAL wave-1 inputs (mpd-default-7332aba4 t7 + t10) through the post-fix planQualityFollowUp still yields a repair whose own acceptance carries finding F3's requiredFix while AGENTS.md classifies out_of_scope — the same rejection/declare-unmatched outcome on t13 that the task body says this fix exists to prevent ('a fix that only narrows the window is not a pass'). The function's doc comment claims the opposite mechanism ('carved OUT of the source contract's outOfScope'). The self-fix test's comment (self-fix-tests/scope-glob-and-contract.test.mjs:133-135) states 'the required edit is no longer out_of_scope' while its own assertion on the next line expects out_of_scope.
findings.requiredFix: Make the generated repair scope actually admit every finding file its acceptance demands: carve the finding's forbidden path out of outOfScope (drop or narrow the covering pattern) instead of only skipping the inScope admission, so classifyChangedPath(finding.file, generated.inScope, generated.outOfScope)==='in_scope' for each finding with a valid file; add a falsifiable regression test built from the real t13 inputs asserting that; correct the contradicting comment in self-fix-tests/scope-glob-and-contract.test.mjs.

findings.problem: 17 added lines of behaviour-changing adopted-code edits sit outside every mpd-delta region: the rewritten inScopeOverlap body (252-255), the new normalizeScopePattern helper (263-267) and the create-time contractContradiction gate inside validateCreateTask (405-412). t4 acceptance 4 requires every adopted-code change to be marked in-source as a LOCAL ADAPTATION; these are not, so they are also invisible to the re-apply guard.
findings.requiredFix: Wrap the three edits in registered mpd-delta regions (e.g. scope-overlap-glob and create-contract-gate) beside their code and regenerate lib/mpd-deltas.js with --write-registry, or move the code into an existing marked region.

findings.problem: The healing path that scripts/vendor-agent-teams.mjs runs unconditionally (applyAgentTeamsFixes({write:true}), vendor-agent-teams.mjs:122) inserts a missing region before its anchor without checking that the file still carries the declaration the region replaces. On the hand re-materialize the guard exists for (upstream file, our registry), --write exits 0 and the next --check exits 0 while the healed file holds two `export function pathMatchesScope` declarations and the module fails to import ('Identifier pathMatchesScope has already been declared'); the unmarked changes (F2) are silently absent from the healed file.
findings.requiredFix: Before inserting, refuse when the target file still contains the declaration/body the region would (re)define (or verify after healing that the file parses/imports and that no symbol the region declares appeared twice), and make vendor-agent-teams.mjs surface that refusal as a failure instead of a green 'applied'. Cover it with a test that heals an upstream (regions-absent) copy and asserts a non-zero exit rather than a broken module.

notes: The live tree was never mutated by this verification: the guard was exercised on sha256-identical sandbox copies so concurrent members (t6/t9) were never exposed to a stripped file.

Every pre-fix measurement comes from the git HEAD revision extracted with git archive; every post-fix measurement comes from the working-tree module that the mounted boot also loaded (probe: 14/14 tools incl. the t4 tool).
